difficulty: four lists whose markers are typed in the text: arrow, bullet character, check mark, hyphen-minus
title: Field Trip Preparation
key_sentences: Pupils from Year 5 will visit the Dunmore Museum of Industry on 14 May.
Teachers should work through the four lists below in the week before the trip.
Complete these steps in the order shown.
Each pupil should pack the following items.
The group leader ticks each point at the museum gate.
The museum does not permit the following.
Buses leave the school gate at half past eight and return by four.

list_items.text: → Confirm the bus booking with the depot
→ Print the route map for each group leader
• A packed lunch and a water bottle
- Large bags in the exhibition halls

notes: No CSS list markers are used: every marker is a character typed in the text, followed by one space: U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW, U+2022 BULLET, U+2713 CHECK MARK and U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS. list_items therefore include the marker. Items have no final full stop. The check mark may be drawn from a fallback font.
